Release notes

What changed in each version of Sunmeld. Sunmeld is still in development, so there are no notes for now.

Beta 1.0.0 (15) · 2026-11-06

Test build: Rush mode, internal trial

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • Rush mode is in an internal trial in this build.
  • You can play the first few Rush rounds for free; after that, continuing needs the one-time purchase.
  • The first lap of Rush is a little easier now. From the second lap on, nothing changes.
  • The Rush leaderboard is not switched on in this build.

Beta 1.0.0 (14) · 2026-11-06

Test build: release notes open inside the app

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • Release notes now open in a sheet inside the app instead of sending you out to the browser.
  • The sheet works on iPhone and iPad, and you can close it to land right back where you were.
  • Nothing changes in how the game plays.

Beta 1.0.0 (13) · 2026-11-05

Test build: a layout made for iPad

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • On iPad the home, game and result screens now have their own layout instead of a stretched phone screen, with a bigger tub and larger text.
  • iPad now works in landscape too: the rival sits on the left, the tub in the middle and your side on the right.
  • Settings, help and other panels open as a centred card on iPad. Nothing changes on phones.

Beta 1.0.0 (12) · 2026-11-05

Test build: groundwork for the next league

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • Under the hood: the computer opponent can now think two moves ahead on a background thread. It is not switched on in the current leagues.
  • The next league and its two new rivals are built but still hidden, so nothing changes in what you play today.
  • The new rivals' names and texts are ready in the 12 supported languages.

Beta 1.0.0 (11) · 2026-11-05

Test build: nickname and your records

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • You can now set a nickname in Settings. It stays on your device, and the game asks once on first launch.
  • A new My records screen in Settings shows your league points, best Hard win and longest win streak, plus wins per difficulty.
  • Records are kept on your device only for now. Online leaderboards are not switched on yet.
  • All new text is available in the 12 supported languages.

Beta 1.0.0 (10) · 2026-11-05

Test build: clearer settings for screen readers

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • Sound, haptics and theme switches now read out their name and state together (for example, "Sound, on") with screen readers.
  • Checked all 12 languages for missing, mixed-script or overlong text, and checked the settings sheets at large text sizes on small screens.
  • Confirmed that haptics fire on real game events.

Beta 1.0.0 (9) · 2026-11-05

Test build: haptics, sound switch, speed check

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • Haptic feedback when you drop a stone, merge, chain merges or the stack nears the top. You can turn haptics and sound off in Settings (there are no sound effects yet).
  • Settings now has a "Copy problem report" button that copies a short diagnostic log, with no personal data, to share with us.
  • Checked the computer opponent's thinking time to keep play smooth.

Beta 1.0.0 (8) · 2026-11-04

Test build: new app icon

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • New app icon: a flat, simple sun with its orbiting stones, on a plain background.

Beta 1.0.0 (7) · 2026-11-03

Test build: daily challenge and customization

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • Daily challenge: one new game each day, the same for everyone that day, with your streak and stars saved and a card on the home screen.
  • Customization: choose from 3 stone shapes and 3 bucket patterns, unlocked as you progress. Nothing is sold.
  • Now available in 12 languages for the new screens.

Beta 1.0.0 (6) · 2026-11-03

Test build: turn-swapping first move and League 2 unlock

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • Comeback device: the first move now alternates between games, and a finale zone adds a last push near the end.
  • League 2 can now be unlocked with a one-time purchase, with a purchase screen and restore. Testers use sandbox accounts only.
  • Stability improvements.

Beta 1.0.0 (5) · 2026-11-03

Test build: League 1 and a clearer start

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • League 1: play against AI opponents that each have their own habits.
  • League results are scored by stars, with a clear rule for how many you earn.
  • A short tutorial walks you through the first game.
  • Special stones now come with an in-game explanation.
  • Resume a saved game right where you left off.
  • Accessibility: screen reader labels and support for larger text.

Last updated: 2026-11-06
